svg.title: Minimum-variance frontier with short positions allowed
svg.desc: Expected growth rate against growth-rate standard deviation, both in inverse years. The red upper branch is the efficient frontier. Portfolio 2, in blue, is the global minimum-variance portfolio. Portfolios 1 and 3 have the same risk, but portfolio 1 has higher expected growth. Portfolio 3 lies on the gray dashed lower branch. This is a schematic, not fitted data.
